resources.string: Liquid Glass look and extra features for Spotify
Enable LiquidSpot in LSPosed Manager and open this screen from there.
Spotify is in the module scope
Spotify is not in the module scope
Changes apply the next time Spotify opens. Force stop it to apply now.
Floating glass pill with the tabs. Needs a Spotify restart to turn on or off.
Turns the mini player into a floating glass pill.
Full-screen player with blurred cover, glass buttons, the song\'s Canvas video and synced lyrics from 14 sources. Ads and podcasts keep Spotify\'s player.
Turns Spotify\'s dark backgrounds into pure black, and the glass gets darker too. Restart Spotify to apply.
Replaces Spotify\'s green (buttons, active icons, progress) with a color of your choice, including the glass screens.
The glass screens change right away; the rest of Spotify changes after you restart it.

The player searches every enabled source at once and uses the first one in this order that has synced lyrics. Plain text is only used when no source has timings. Syllable sources light up word by word.
Used by the three PaxSenix sources. Leave it empty to skip them.

Optional. Downloads the wav2vec2-base-960h speech model (Meta, via Hugging Face) and the ONNX Runtime engine. In the lyrics view, the button on the left listens to the song and times line-synced lyrics syllable by syllable. Works best in English and Latin-alphabet lyrics.
Model installed; the engine is missing
Songs already synced by the AI play synced right away next time. Each song takes about 10 KB in Spotify\'s cache.
Spotify\'s own lyrics, through the SpotifyPlus API
Apple timings by recording, syllable by syllable
The same Apple timings, matched on the recording itself
Apple Music timings, word by word
QQ Music karaoke timings through BetterLyrics
Syllable by syllable, on community mirrors
Whole lines, strong outside the English catalogue
Whole lines, free and always up
Needs a signing key; usually returns nothing
Blurs what\'s behind Connect, the \"…\" menus and dialogs.
Keeps the music playing in the background even when Spotify is cleared from recent apps. Restart Spotify to apply.
Writes the structure of the tab bar, player and sheets to the log the next time they open. Use it to report problems.
Hold and drag across the tabs to lift a glass lens that magnifies what\'s under it. Liquid style only.
Scrolling down turns the tabs into a circle and moves the mini player into the bar, like iOS 26. Scroll up or tap the circle to bring them back.
Only the cover, the song, pause and next, without the Connect and add buttons.
Always shows the cover instead of the song\'s short looping video.
Shows the line being sung above the progress bar; tap it to open the lyrics.
The Frosted blur with a firmer color, without the Liquid Glass edges and shine.
Blur and lens refraction. On Android 12 it uses Frosted.
Stronger blur, no lens. Lighter on the battery.
Turns off the spring animations of the bar and the player, and the syllable-by-syllable lyrics animation.
Connect the LSPosed service to change features.
Inspired by spoti.pw, a Spotify tweak for iOS by skopevoj. LiquidSpot is an independent reimplementation for Android and uses none of its code.
Hook architecture inspired by SpotifyPlus by LeNerd46. Glass and navigation bar adapted from BitChord by kushagrasinghx.
Meta speech model for the AI (optional download)
Free software under the GNU GPL v3.
LiquidSpot is not affiliated with Spotify.
Glass back, share and more buttons on artist, album and playlist pages, a big fading cover at the top of albums and playlists and thin lines between songs.
